findings.title: Image user should not be 'root'
findings.message: Specify at least 1 USER command in Dockerfile with non-root user as argument
findings.remediation: Add 'USER <non root user name>' line to the Dockerfile
findings.verification_note: Konfiguratsiya fayli statik tekshirildi; fayl bajarilmagan va bu sozlama amalda qanday ta’sir qilishi tasdiqlanmagan. Mutaxassis ko‘rib chiqishi shart.

findings.title: No HEALTHCHECK defined
findings.message: Add HEALTHCHECK instruction in your Dockerfile
findings.verification_note: Konfiguratsiya fayli statik tekshirildi; fayl bajarilmagan va bu sozlama amalda qanday ta’sir qilishi tasdiqlanmagan. Mutaxassis ko‘rib chiqishi shart.

limits: Trivy `config` rejimi: Dockerfile, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation, Helm va ARM fayllari statik tekshiriladi. Compose va Nginx uchun alohida Repository bosqichi ishlaydi. Hech bir fayl bajarilmaydi; topilmalar amalda ekspluatatsiya qilinishi tekshirilmagan.
coverage_scope: Joriy matn fayllari; Git tarixi, vendor/node_modules, binar va 1 MB dan katta fayllar kiritilmagan.
untagged_note: Bu tekshiruvlar uchun CWE xaritada yo‘q; ular o‘z ID si bilan ko‘rsatiladi va hech qanday OWASP toifasiga taxmin qilinmaydi.

verification_summary.note: confirmed_by_evidence: nishonning haqiqiy javobi/holati bilan bevosita kuzatilgan. manual_review_required: statik yoki bazaviy moslik — mutaxassis tomonidan qo‘lda tasdiqlanishi shart.
